facts.text: I want the laziest way to invest my money to generate passive income.
I asked whether, if my goals and risk tolerance don't change, I have nothing to do for several years if I choose a long-term goal.
I want to know how to ensure that I am on track to meet my investment goals.
I thought a robo-advisor would do everything for me and I asked whether I have to balance my portfolio myself.
I asked whether I have anything to do to react if something major happens with market conditions or economic trends.
I asked whether I just have to keep investing regularly and when I stop investing.
I do not understand the explanation about dollar-cost averaging and asked for it to be explained.
